meaning: Evaluation-only saved-model probe: for retained/copy anchor targets, positive abs_sensitivity means masking visible source-absent compact-content context worsens copied-anchor prediction. Matched function/copied controls test generic extra-mask versus anchor/copy-context dependence.

interpretation_keys.ACA_support: source-absent context perturbation should hurt copied-anchor prediction more than matched function perturbation, especially for contexts containing relational/event source-absent words; if full/drop_abs share sensitivity, input exposure rather than source-absent target loss is sufficient for this context role.
interpretation_keys.copy_anchor_dominance: copied-context matched perturbation much larger than source-absent perturbation means anchor prediction is dominated by other copied lexical anchors, not novel compact context.
interpretation_keys.negative_result: near-zero source-absent sensitivity, or sensitivity no larger than matched function masking, weakens anchor-conditioned abstraction and points back to generic input distribution / supervision mass.
